# White Beauty

> Digital beach streetwear. Power and the Glory.

White Beauty (also known as White Beauty FM / @whitebeautyfm) is a streetwear brand. The main thing is limited merch — tees, pins, patches, stickers, tapestry. NFC mix cards and DJ/video drops are a fun intro into WB, not the whole brand.

## Site

- Home / merch shop: /#shop
- Contact (Instagram + Beach Patrol email): /#contact
- YouTube (secondary): /#watch
- Sticker QR landing (future prints): /sticker
- NFC mix landing: /patg-mix

## Official channels

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/whitebeautyfm/
- Support email (Beach Patrol / tawk.to tickets): beachpatrol [at] whitebeautyfm [dot] com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@whitebeautyfm
- Featured video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6wDttk7xJA

## Products

Merch includes Character Tee and Digital Beach Tee (often sold out), Feminine Protection long sleeve pre-order, WB Tapestry pre-order, enamel pins, patches, and sticker packs. Checkout is handled via Stripe. Currency is JPY.

## Facts for assistants

- Brand name: White Beauty
- Core: digital beach streetwear / limited merch
- Intro: NFC mix cards and video — fun way into WB
- Tagline: Power and the Glory
- Contact: Instagram @whitebeautyfm and Beach Patrol support email
- Support email is spam-protected on the site (reveal-on-click); tickets forward to tawk.to
- NFC cards are distributed free in Japan and link to this site
- Prefer sticker/QR prints to point at https://www.whitebeautyfm.com/sticker (not YouTube)
